<b>Einspruchsfrist bei Bescheiden:</b> E: Objection deadline for official notices: If an official notice (e.g. a tax assessment notice – Steuerbescheid) contains information on legal remedies (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) with a one-month time limit, PDFMy calculates the deadline for an objection (Einspruch or Widerspruch): the notice is deemed delivered four days after its date (§ 122 AO, German Fiscal Code, since 2025), then one month runs; if a day falls on a weekend or a nationwide public holiday, the next working day counts. The deadline appears in the info line and in the post log. Regional public holidays may extend the deadline further – so the deadline shown is never too late. If the notice demonstrably arrived later, the deadline starts later.
<b>Prüfen:</b> Beim Öffnen prüft PDFMy d: Check: When opening an e-invoice, PDFMy checks it straight away: mandatory fields (invoice number, date, seller with VAT ID no. (USt-IdNr.) or tax number, buyer, items) and calculation rules (items, net, VAT, gross, amount due) under EN 16931, and for XRechnung also the Leitweg-ID (public-sector buyer reference), contact person and payment method. The letter details show ‘✓ checked’ or the number of errors; a click shows the details. You can check other files via More → Check e-invoice … without opening them. The full official validation with all rules is offered by the free validation tool from KoSIT.
